Senior QA Automation Engineer - Holycode team
Senior QA Automation/Manual with Playwright AND Typescript
Senior QA Test Automation with TS + Playwright, Remote
QA Engineer (Automation)
jobs.description:
WHY SPEKTR
At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.
Compliance, built like product.
Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.
We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.
It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.
$26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.
Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.
Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.
THE OPPORTUNITY
We’re looking for a
QA Automation Engineer
to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.
What You Will Be Doing
Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.
Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.
API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.
CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.
Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.
Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.
What We Are Looking For
The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.
Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.
API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.
Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.
Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.
Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.
Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.
OUR TECH INTERESTS
Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript
Testing: Playwright
AI/ML: LLM Prompting, LangChain/AutoGPT concepts, Evals frameworks
Infrastructure: API-driven architectures, SQL databases, CI/CD pipelines
OUR PROCESS
Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)
Technical Interview (30 minutes)
Technical Interview (60 minutes)
How To Apply
We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.
spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

jobs.title: QA Engineer (Power Platform, Copilot Studio & ITSM)
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Our client is a world-leading reinsurance and risk management company, delivering comprehensive solutions across insurance, underwriting, and data-driven risk assessment. With a strong focus on innovation and long-term stability, they support clients in addressing complex risks and driving sustainable value in an ever-changing global landscape.We are looking for experienced QA Engineers to support Product Owners in ensuring the quality and reliability of AI-enabled ITSM solutions built on Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio.
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive QA Engineer with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to support Product Owners in ensuring the quality of AI-enabled ITSM solutions built on Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio. The role covers test planning, manual and automated testing, and release readiness, requiring close collaboration with Product Owners and development teams.
What You'll Be Doing
Review User Stories and acceptance criteria together with Product Owners, identifying gaps, ambiguities, and potential testing risks early in the development process.
Design, prepare, and execute test plans, test cases, and regression test suites for Power Apps, Power Automate flows, and Dataverse components.
Test Copilot Studio agents and topics, validating conversational flows, intent recognition, response accuracy, fallback behavior, and responsible AI safeguards.
Validate end-to-end ITSM processes, including Incident Management, Request Management, Change Management, and Knowledge Management.
Perform functional, integration, regression, API, and UI testing to ensure solution quality and reliability.
Build and maintain automated tests for repeatable scenarios using tools such as Power Apps Test Engine, Playwright, Selenium, or Postman.
Identify, document, track, and manage defects in Jira, collaborating with developers to ensure timely resolution and verification of fixes.
Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing test data, guiding business testers, and consolidating feedback.
Monitor testing progress and report quality metrics, defects, and potential risks.
Contribute to release readiness activities by preparing test summary reports, providing go/no-go recommendations, and performing post-release validation.
Collaborate with Product Owners, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment between business requirements and delivered solutions.
What You'll Bring Along
Bachelor's degree in Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
At least 6 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing, including at least 1–2 years of experience working with Microsoft Power Platform solutions.
Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse.
Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio and experience testing conversational AI or GenAI-based solutions.
Solid understanding of ITSM processes and platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or equivalent.
Experience with manual testing, test planning, test case design, and regression testing.
Experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Power Apps Test Engine, Playwright, Selenium, or Postman for API testing.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using Jira for defect tracking and test management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders.
Excellent command of both spoken and written English. Nice to Have
ITIL v4 Foundation certification or higher.
ISTQB certification.
Microsoft certifications such as PL-900, PL-200, or AI-900.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, particularly Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
Knowledge of Power Platform Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).
Familiarity with LLM evaluation approaches, including test datasets, response quality scoring, and hallucination detection.
Basic scripting knowledge in Python, JavaScript, or PowerShell.
